name: @anvaya/server
description: Anvaya collector and analysis server — ingest, detect, attribute, store, serve

scripts.dev: concurrently -n tsc,srv -c gray,cyan "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch dist/cli.js serve"
scripts.prepack: node -e "const{cpSync,existsSync,rmSync}=require('fs');if(!existsSync('../ui/dist/index.html'))throw new Error('UI bundle missing - run npm run build at the repo root before packing');rmSync('dist/ui',{recursive:true,force:true});cpSync('../ui/dist','dist/ui',{recursive:true});console.log('bundled dashboard into dist/ui')"

author: Ashutosh Siddh
